figurative_meaning_en: troubles and turmoils, sorrow and misery, obstacles and adversities
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনে বিপদআপদের মতো অনেক কষ্ট এসেছে।
বন্ধুরা বিপদআপদে পাশে থাকলে সবকিছু সহজ হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He has faced many troubles and turmoils in his life.
Friends should stand by during times of danger and calamity.
note: This idiom emphasizes solidarity in difficult times, a common theme in Bengali folklore and proverbs.
